apartment.toy: A small plush rabbit, soaked through. A name tag on its ear reads: MIA · HARLOW HOUSE.
apartment.bag: Her backpack, torn open. Inside is a crayon drawing of a tall apartment building with a light over the door. Scuff marks lead {d}.
apartment.note: Written on a receipt in a child's hand: “Mom said if anything happens, wait inside our building by the mailboxes. Don't go outside.”
apartment.prints: Small muddy footprints. They cross the sidewalk and stop at the door of an apartment building.
apartment.cry: Faint crying from the {d}. Muffled, as if behind walls.

shop.toy: A small plush rabbit, soaked through. A price sticker on its foot: MARLOWE'S, $2.
shop.bag: Her backpack. Inside is a crayon drawing of a shop with a crooked orange sign. Scuff marks lead {d}.
shop.note: “The shop with the broken sign is dark and nobody is there. I'll hide behind the counter. Don't go outside.”
shop.prints: Small footprints on the wet pavement. They lead into a dark shop.
shop.cry: Faint crying from the {d}. Muffled, as if behind glass.

park.toy: A small plush rabbit, soaked through. Wet leaves and grass are stuck in its fur.
park.bag: Her backpack. Pine needles are caught in the zipper, and there is a drawing of trees around a fountain. Scuff marks lead {d}.
park.note: “There is a little house in the park with a door that doesn't lock. I'll hide there. Don't go outside.”
park.prints: Small footprints pressed into the mud between the trees. They lead to a small park building.
park.cry: Crying, carried on the wind from the {d}. Somewhere open, near trees.

subroom.toy: A small plush rabbit, soaked through. A subway card is clipped to its ear.
subroom.bag: Her backpack. Inside is a crayon drawing of a train sleeping under the street. Scuff marks lead {d}.
subroom.note: “It's too big to fit down the stairs. I'll hide in the workers' room next to the platform. Don't go outside.”
subroom.prints: Small wet footprints. They lead down the stairs into the subway.
subroom.cry: Faint crying, echoing up from somewhere under the street.

tunnel.toy: A small plush rabbit, soaked through. A subway card is clipped to its ear.
tunnel.bag: Her backpack. Inside is a crayon drawing of a long dark tunnel with train tracks. Scuff marks lead {d}.
tunnel.note: “It's too big to fit down the stairs. I'll follow the train tracks until they end. Don't go outside.”
tunnel.prints: Small wet footprints. They lead down the stairs into the subway.
tunnel.cry: Faint crying, echoing up from somewhere under the street.

wxMsg.clear: The rain has stopped. Every footstep carries now.
wxMsg.drizzle: Light rain. Your footsteps carry further.
wxMsg.rain: The rain is picking up. It covers some of your noise.
wxMsg.storm: A storm is rolling in. It will struggle to hear you.
